name: NRRD-like Volume I/O
definition: Exports and imports volumes in a simple NRRD-like format consisting of two header lines followed by raw binary payload.
summary: NRRD-like Volume I/O is a lightweight, fast format for serializing 3D uint32 voxel grids using a two-line header and raw binary payload, prioritizing simplicity over the flexibility of full NRRD.
